topic: Reserving the Community Grill for a Block Party

script.title: THE PARK GRILL
script.scene_zh: 社區辦公室 · 預約烤爐
script.story_hook: A block party starts with one simple booking.
script.intro_zh: 一場街區派對，從一個簡單的預約開始。
script.welcome_en: Hey, today we're at the parks office. Listen for booking and rules phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嘿，今天我們來到公園管理辦公室。留意預約和規則的說法。
script.outro: And the grill is booked. Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 烤爐就這樣訂好了。再聽一次，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: we'll move your date for free
script.char_a_description: a man in his thirties with short black hair, warm brown skin, a short trimmed beard, an olive green henley shirt, blue jeans, and an average build
script.char_b_description: a tall woman in her forties with a chin-length auburn bob, thin square glasses, a tan park-ranger polo shirt, a name badge, and a slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to reserve the park grill, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə ɹɪˈzɝv ðə pɑɹk ɡɹɪl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想預約公園的烤爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing, is that for a block party?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ ɪz ðæt fɚ ə blɑk ˈpɑɹti/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，是用來辦街區派對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, the whole street is coming this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm ðə hoʊl stɹit ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ðɪs jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，今年整條街的人都會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! When are you hoping to set it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɛn ɑɹ ju ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə sɛt ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 真好！你們打算哪天辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second Saturday in September, after six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈsætədeɪ ɪn səpˈtɛmbɚ ˈæftɚ sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 九月的第二個週六，傍晚六點之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... yes, the grill's open that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk jɛs ðə ɡɹɪlz ˈoʊpən ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下⋯⋯有的，那天烤爐是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Do I need a permit for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du aɪ nid ə ˈpɝmɪt fɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這種派對需要申請許可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do, it's thirty dollars, that's the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du ɪts ˈθɜɹti ˈdɑlərz ðæts ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 需要，費用是三十塊，那就是許可費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, thirty, no problem. How long is approval?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈθɜɹti noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm haʊ lɔŋ ɪz əˈpɹuːvəl/
dialogue.zh: 好，三十塊，沒問題。核准要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually a week, but I can rush it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli ə wik bʌt aɪ kən ɹʌʃ ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 通常一週，但我今天可以幫你加急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would be amazing, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd bi əˈmeɪzɪŋ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，真的幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to. I just need your name and address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə aɪ dʒʌst nid jɔɹ neɪm ænd əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。我只要你的姓名和地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Leo, and I'm two blocks down the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈlioʊ ænd aɪm tu blɑks daʊn ðə stɹit/
dialogue.zh: 我叫 Leo，就住這條街往下兩個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, so a permit for the big grill here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt soʊ ə ˈpɝmɪt fɚ ðə bɪɡ ɡɹɪl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，那就是申請這邊的大烤爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big one, yes. Can we use both picnic tables?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn jɛs kən wi juz boʊ θ ˈpɪknɪk ˈteɪbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 對，大的那個。我們可以用兩張野餐桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tables come with the grill at no extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈteɪbəlz kʌm wɪð ðə ɡɹɪl ət noʊ ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 可以，用烤爐就附桌子，不用另外收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, are there any rules I should know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʌm ɑɹ ðɛɹ ˈɛni ɹulz aɪ ʃʊd noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 完美。嗯，有什麼規定是我該知道的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Main one is clean-up, you leave it spotless.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪn wʌn ɪz klin ʌp ju liv ɪt ˈspɑtləs/
dialogue.zh: 最重要的一條是清理，離開前要清得乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair, we'll bring our own trash bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛr wil bɹɪŋ ɑʊɹ on tɹæʃ bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 很合理，我們會自備垃圾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thinking, we only provide one small bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ wi ˈoʊnli pɹəˈvaɪd wʌn smɔl bɪn/
dialogue.zh: 想得周到，我們這裡只有一個小垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. What about noise, is there a time limit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd wʌt əˈbaʊt nɔɪz ɪz ðɛɹ ə taɪm ˈlɪmɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。那噪音呢，有沒有時間限制？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, quiet hours start at ten sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈkwaɪət aʊɚz stɑɹt ət tɛn ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 有，安靜時段從十點整開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten, okay, we should be done by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn oʊˈkeɪ wi ʃʊd bi dʌn baɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十點，好，我們那時應該已經結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music is fine till ten, just keep it mellow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmjuːzɪk ɪz faɪn tɪl tɛn dʒʌst kip ɪt ˈmɛloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 十點前放音樂沒問題，只要音量柔和一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Can we bring our own drinks, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du kən wi bɹɪŋ ɑʊɹ on dɹɪŋks tu/
dialogue.zh: 我會注意。那我們可以自備飲料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drinks are fine, but no glass bottles, that's key.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɹɪŋkz ɑɹ faɪn bʌt noʊ ɡlæs ˈbɑɾəlz ðæts ki/
dialogue.zh: 飲料可以，但不能帶玻璃瓶，這點很關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, no glass. Can I bring my own folding chairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ɡlæs kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ on ˈfoʊldɪŋ tʃɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，不能帶玻璃。那我可以帶自己的折疊椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chairs are okay, just no open flame nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛɹz ɑɹ oʊˈkeɪ dʒʌst noʊ ˈoʊpən fleɪm nɪɹˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 椅子沒問題，只要旁邊不要有明火就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. The grill is already there, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ðə ɡɹɪl ɪz ɔlˈɛdɛ ðɛɹ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 明白了。烤爐是已經裝在那裡的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and we light it for you at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd wi laɪt ɪt fɚ ju ət sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 是的，六點我們會幫你點火。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six works. Can guests arrive a bit earlier?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wɝks kən ɡɛsts əˈɹaɪv ə bɪt ˈɜɹliɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六點可以。那客人能早一點到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time, you just can't lock the gate behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm ju dʒʌst kænt lɑk ðə ɡeɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ju/
dialogue.zh: 隨時都行，只是離開時別把柵欄鎖上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Can I pay the fee online later today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kuːl kæn aɪ peɪ ðə fi oʊnˈlaɪn ˈleɪɾɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。那費用我今天可以在線上繳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll email a link, pay before the party day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ˈimeɪl ə lɪŋk peɪ bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ˈpɑɹti deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我會傳連結給你，派對前先繳好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, can I add a backup person?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʌm kæn aɪ æd ə ˈbækˌʌp ˈpɝsən/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。嗯，我能在文件上加一個備用人選嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, backups are smart, in case you get sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈbækˌʌps ɑɹ smɑɹt ɪn keɪs ju ɡɛt sɪk/
dialogue.zh: 當然，備用人選很聰明，就怕你那天生病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, my neighbor can grab the key if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ ˈneɪbɚ kən ɡɹæb ðə ki ɪf ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，需要的話鄰居可以來拿鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hand out one key, they're numbered for tracking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hænd aʊt wʌn ki ðeɹ ˈnʌmbɚd fɚ ˈtɹækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們只發一把鑰匙，上面有編號方便追蹤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. What time is the park usually crowded?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt taɪm ɪz ðə pɑɹk ˈjuʒuəli ˈkɹaʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 好。公園通常幾點會開始人多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday evenings fill up fast, so come early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætədeɪ ˈivnɪŋz fɪl ʌp fæst soʊ kʌm ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 週六傍晚很快就滿，所以要早一點來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll get there at five to set everything up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ɡɛt ðɛɹ ət faɪv tə sɛt ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我們五點就到，先把所有東西擺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good, and I'll note that on your file.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd ænd aɪl noʊt ðæt ɑn jɔɹ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯，我會把這點寫進你的文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're so helpful, thank you for all this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ soʊ ˈhɛlpfəl θæŋk ju fɚ ɔl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你真是太幫忙了，謝謝你處理這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my job, but I do love the block parties.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dʒɑb bʌt aɪ du lʌv ðə blɑk ˈpɑɹtiz/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作，但我真的很愛街區派對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, well, I'll save you a burger, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɛl aɪl seɪv ju ə ˈbɝɡɚ dil/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那我一定幫你留一個漢堡，說定囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got a deal. Now I'll process this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊz ɡɑt ə dil naʊ aɪl ˈpɹɑsɛs ðɪs fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 一言為定。我現在來幫你處理表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. And what happens after I pay the fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd wʌt ˈhæpənz ˈæftɚ aɪ peɪ ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我繳完費之後會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a confirmation email, then you're all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt ə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən ˈimeɪl ðɛn jʊɹ ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 你會收到一封確認信，然後就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Is the grill behind a fence, or open?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ðə ɡɹɪl bɪˈhaɪnd ə fɛns ɔɹ ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。烤爐是有圍欄隔開的，還是開放的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's open, right next to the playground over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊpən ɹaɪt nɛkst tə ðə ˈpleɪˌɡɹaʊnd ˈoʊvɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是開放的，就在那邊的遊樂場旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's actually perfect for the kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ˈpɝfɪkt fɚ ðə kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 那樣對孩子們來說實在是太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a nice spot. Anything else for your booking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə naɪs spɑt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls fɚ jɔɹ ˈbʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那邊確實很棒。你的預約還有別的要了解嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, just one thing, what if it rains that Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm dʒʌst wʌn θɪŋ wʌt ɪf ɪt ɹeɪnz ðæt ˈsætədeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，只剩一件事，如果那個週六下雨怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us by noon, we'll move your date for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ʌs baɪ nun wil muːv jɔɹ deɪt fɚ fri/
dialogue.zh: 中午前打給我們，我們會免費幫你改日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's so reasonable, I love that policy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts soʊ ˈɹizənəbəl aɪ lʌv ðæt ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 這規定太周到了，我很喜歡這個政策。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, we try. So, ready to sign right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ wi tɹaɪ soʊ ˈɹɛdi tə saɪn ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我們盡力而為。好，準備在這裡簽名了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll sign. Where does my name go?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl saɪn wɛɹ dʌz maɪ neɪm ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我簽。我的名字寫哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right on this line, and that's all I need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɑn ðɪs laɪn ænd ðæts ɔl aɪ nid/
dialogue.zh: 就在這條線上，其他都不用寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Thanks again for answering all my questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn θæŋks əˈɡɛn fɚ ˈænsəɹɪŋ ɔl maɪ ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。再次謝謝你回答我這麼多問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Have a great party, Leo, see you then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˈpɑɹti ˈlioʊ si ju ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。玩得開心點，Leo，到時候見。

script.youtube_title: 【街區派對申請🍔】「下雨免費幫你改日期」公園烤爐預約全流程聽力🎧｜聽完就會用預約英語💬｜60句沉浸式｜Reserving a Park Grill
script.youtube_title_en: "We'll Move Your Date for Free" — Reserving a Community Grill for a Block Party
script.youtube_description:
「下雨免費幫你改日期」——想為整條街的鄰里辦一場派對，走進公園管理辦公室，才發現預約烤爐有這麼多細節。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區辦公室的櫃檯前。

你會聽到：怎麼問許可與費用、核准要多久、野餐桌和垃圾清理、安靜時段與音量、不能帶玻璃瓶、線上繳費、備用聯絡人，還有下雨怎麼改日期。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與美國人日常短句，um、well、so、haha 這些自然語感詞通通都在。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就會記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en: "We'll move your date for free" — you want to throw a block party for the whole street, but reserving the park grill has a lot of details. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the parks office counter. You will hear asking about the permit and fee, how long approval takes, picnic tables and clean-up, quiet hours and volume, no glass bottles, paying online, a backup name, and what happens when it rains.
